author.match: Match each memoir to its author.

rows.label: Man's Search for Meaning
rows.author: Viktor Frankl
rows.hook: argues from a psychologist's time in concentration camps that finding purpose helps people endure suffering

rows.label: Tuesdays with Morrie
rows.author: Mitch Albom
rows.hook: recounts a journalist's weekly visits to his dying former college professor and the life lessons he shared

rows.label: The Glass Castle
rows.author: Jeannette Walls
rows.hook: recounts a nomadic, poor childhood with brilliant, dysfunctional parents who promised a dream home

rows.label: Maus
rows.author: Art Spiegelman
rows.hook: tells a Holocaust survivor's story as a comic with animal characters, winning a Pulitzer

rows.label: Educated
rows.author: Tara Westover
rows.hook: tells how a woman raised by survivalist parents with no schooling went on to earn a Cambridge doctorate

rows.label: I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings
rows.author: Maya Angelou
rows.description: 1969 autobiography about the early years of African-American writer and poet Maya Angelou
rows.hook: follows a Black girl raised in Arkansas through trauma and prejudice, in the first of seven volumes

rows.label: Angela's Ashes
rows.author: Frank McCourt
rows.hook: recounts a poverty-stricken Irish childhood in Limerick and won a Pulitzer Prize for autobiography

rows.label: The Year of Magical Thinking
rows.author: Joan Didion
rows.hook: chronicles a writer's grief after her husband suddenly died, and won the National Book Award

rows.label: Night
rows.author: Elie Wiesel
rows.description: 1956 memoir in yiddish by Elie Wiesel translated  from the French version into English in 1960 and 1981 by Stella Rodway, published in 1982
rows.hook: recounts a teenage boy's loss of faith and survival alongside his father in Nazi death camps

rows.label: Persepolis
rows.author: Marjane Satrapi
rows.description: 2000–2003 French-language graphic novel series by Marjane Satrapi
rows.hook: tells in black-and-white comics a girl's coming of age during the Iranian Revolution and later life in Europe

rows.label: Into Thin Air
rows.author: Jon Krakauer
rows.description: 1997 account of The Mt. Everest disaster
rows.hook: gives a first-hand account of the storm on the world's tallest mountain that killed eight climbers
